prompt:
Production Unity enemy Tank animation sheet. Input reference is exact silhouette, proportions and view, not a frame to duplicate. Redraw the same creature with articulated animated poses. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray tendon limbs, subtle amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D, elevated 45deg camera fixed, soft upper-left light. Massive squat broad quadruped with thick layered irregular rock-brown armor boulders, huge pale gray sinewy muscular FOUR legs, blunt low armored head and amber eye slit, broad heavy body. Preserve the reference's wide tank silhouette. No green/red/purple dorsal sacs, no extra limbs or spikes.
Direction MUST remain REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-left, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-left. Never front-left. throughout all frames. Front limbs/head point toward top, hind limbs nearest bottom in rear views. When doing a slam, keep HIND feet nearest viewer braced on ground; raise the FRONT feet far from viewer.
FOUR COLUMNS, 6 ROWS, exactly 24 full creatures, PORTRAIT image width:height=4:6. Generous 20% transparent space around each sprite within its cell. Never overlap/touch any adjacent frame. Same body scale and foot anchor each frame. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Four consistent limbs, one head, same armor layout. No duplicate stills, no rotation-only simulation. Fully transparent background alpha0 and clean transparent gaps between legs. No floor or cast shadows, no text/labels/grid, no particles, no projectile.
